about.location: Ann Arbor, MI // University of Michigan.
about.intro: I'm a Computer Science student at the University of Michigan, graduating December 2027. I like building across the stack, from React apps and ML models to C++ control code for underwater robots.
context: Right now I'm a Tech Lead at Altheros Capital, co-leading a 10-engineer full-stack team on Midwest Health, a healthcare patient-scheduling platform. I plan sprints, review and merge pull requests, and demo our work monthly to a 60-person audience including an Altheros Capital partner. I started there as a Full Stack Developer Intern, building React interfaces and moving the team's build tooling to Vite.

Before that I worked on robotics and machine learning: robotic arm pathfinding at UMass Lowell's PeARL Lab and OpenCV-based autonomous navigation at MIT Lincoln Laboratory's Beaver Works program. This semester I'm taking Machine Learning, Embedded Systems, and Autonomous Robotics.
